title:
POV: I ASKED A BAKER IN ISRAEL FOR BREAD
WITH NO MONEY
beats: THE TEST: 'Salaamu Alaikum. Do you speak English? I want to buy one piece of bread - can I have one, please?'
'I'm sorry, but I don't have money. Can you help me, please?' 'You want one?' 'Yeah, please - I'm just hungry.' 'Thank you so much.'
THE REVEAL: 'Actually, this is for you.' 'No, it's okay.' 'Take it.' 'Thank you.'
'Because you helped me - I want you to give bread for free to other people.'
'What's your name?' 'Muhammad.' 'You are Muslim?' 'Yes.' 'I'm Jewish. We are brothers - Muslims and Jews, we are all the same.'
THE ENDING - a stranger vouches for him: 'He can give it to you free. He's the best guy in the world. He is number one.'
